resources.string: Never send money to someone you have only met online. Keep your address, financial details and identity documents private. When meeting, choose a public place and tell someone you trust.\n\nCalaf is for adults aged 18 and over. Family involvement must always be your choice.
LOCAL DEVELOPMENT · Firebase emulators · Demo accounts only
Swipe or tap the buttons to pass, like or send a kind compliment. Everyone here is a fictional demo member.
When interest is mutual you can chat. In this demo, replies are scripted and clearly labelled.
You choose what is shared, photos can be blurred, and a guardian can follow along if you want.
